goal: Automatically process new Acme cases by updating the contact name, escalating the status, and creating a follow-up task assigned to Shrey Sharma.
summary: This plan automates the daily triage of new cases for the Acme account. It navigates to the Acme Cases list view and drains it: for each case it extracts the contact name, sets the Contact Name field, escalates Status to Escalated, and creates a Call task. Every state-changing step carries a success_condition so it self-skips if the target state is already present, making each iteration idempotent for any partial-completion state.

steps.description: Navigate to the Acme Cases list view
Process each new case in the Acme Cases list view
Click on the first case row link in the Acme Cases list (drain sentinel)

details.target_description: First case number link in the Acme Cases list view

steps.description: Extract the contact name from the email feed on the case

details.description: The sender's name mentioned in the email body of the case feed (e.g., Rachel Torres).

steps.description: Set Contact Name via inline pencil edit — click pencil, type, wait for inline dropdown, click result to create pill
steps.success_condition: The Contact Name field on the case record shows '${contact_name}' as a linked-record pill in read-only view

details.target_description: Save button on the Case Details inline-edit footer

steps.success_condition: The Contact Name field shows '${contact_name}' as a linked-record pill in read-only view — the saved value is visible, not merely that the Save/Cancel footer is gone

steps.description: Set Case Status to Escalated via inline picklist
steps.success_condition: The Status field on the case record shows 'Escalated' in read-only view

details.target_description: Save button on the Case Details inline-edit footer

steps.success_condition: The Status field shows 'Escalated' in read-only view — the saved value is visible, not merely that the Save/Cancel footer is gone

details.target_description: Related tab on the Case page

steps.success_condition: The Related tab is currently the active/selected tab on the case page and its content is visible

steps.description: Create a Call task assigned to Shrey Sharma with all required fields

details.target_description: New Task button in the Open Activities section, then fill and save the New Task modal

fields.Subject: Call
fields.Comments: talk to ${contact_name} and investigate the issue

steps.success_condition: A task with Subject 'Call' assigned to 'Shrey Sharma' is visible in the Open Activities section of the Related tab on this case

steps.description: Wait for the task creation to complete

details.reason: Allow the task creation toast notification to clear and the UI to refresh.

steps.description: Navigate back to the Acme Cases list view

decision_rules.rule: Only process cases that have a status of 'New' in the Acme Cases list view.
decision_rules.inferred_from: Narration: 'Once I click on that and if I see any new cases with a status as new, that's a case which I'm supposed to work on.'

decision_rules.rule: Each processing step self-skips if its target state is already present, making the plan idempotent for any partial-completion state.
decision_rules.inferred_from: Per-step success_conditions checked before acting; the drain loop's backstop pauses if the same record is served twice.

correction_history: Replaced coarse has_Call_task extract+decision with per-step success_conditions for full idempotency across all partial states. Merged New Task click + form fill into one create_task step. Added drain backstop for stuck-loop detection.
